# growthbook_sdk_connections (Data Source)

Lists every GrowthBook SDK connection in the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "growthbook_sdk_connections" "all" {}

output "sdk_connection_names" {
  value = [for c in data.growthbook_sdk_connections.all.sdk_connections : c.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `sdk_connections` (Attributes List) All SDK connections in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sdk_connections))

<a id="nestedatt--sdk_connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sdk_connections`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_custom_fields_in_metadata` (Set of String) Custom field keys allowed in feature metadata.
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether this SDK connection has received at least one request.
- `date_created` (String) Timestamp the connection was created.
- `date_updated` (String) Timestamp the connection was last updated.
- `encrypt_payload` (Boolean) Whether the SDK payload is encrypted.
- `encryption_key` (String, Sensitive) Key used to decrypt an encrypted payload.
- `environment` (String) Environment this connection serves.
- `hash_secure_attributes` (Boolean) Whether secure attributes are hashed before being sent to the SDK.
- `id` (String) SDK connection id.
- `include_custom_fields_in_metadata` (Boolean) Whether custom fields are included in feature metadata.
- `include_draft_experiment_refs` (Boolean) Whether draft experiment references are included in the payload.
- `include_draft_experiments` (Boolean) Whether draft experiments are included in the payload.
- `include_experiment_names` (Boolean) Whether experiment names are included in the payload.
- `include_experiment_schedule_in_metadata` (Boolean) Whether experiment schedules are included in feature metadata.
- `include_project_id_in_metadata` (Boolean) Whether project ids are included in feature metadata.
- `include_redirect_experiments` (Boolean) Whether URL redirect experiments are included in the payload.
- `include_referenced_prerequisites` (Boolean) Whether referenced prerequisite features are included in the payload.
- `include_rule_ids` (Boolean) Whether rule ids are included in the payload.
- `include_tags_in_metadata` (Boolean) Whether tags are included in feature metadata.
- `include_visual_experiments` (Boolean) Whether visual editor experiments are included in the payload.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Client key used by SDKs to fetch this connection's payload.
- `language` (String) First SDK language reported for this connection.
- `name` (String) Display name for the SDK connection.
- `projects` (Set of String) Project ids this connection is scoped to. Empty means all projects.
- `proxy_enabled` (Boolean) Whether GrowthBook Proxy is enabled for this connection.
- `proxy_host` (String) GrowthBook Proxy host URL.
- `proxy_signing_key` (String, Sensitive) Signing key used by GrowthBook Proxy.
- `remote_eval_enabled` (Boolean) Whether remote evaluation is enabled for this connection.
- `saved_group_references_enabled` (Boolean) Whether saved group references are enabled in the payload.
- `sdk_version` (String) SDK version reported to GrowthBook for payload compatibility.
